chunks: And it has been narrated: that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله departed from Minā through the road of Dabb.
And he returned through the route between the two mountain passes.
And he صلى الله عليه وآله, when he took a road, would not return by it.

key_terms.الْمَأْزِمَيْنِ: the two mountain passes or narrow paths between elevations
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, referring to the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.طَرِيقِ ضَبٍّ: the road of Dabb, a specific route mentioned in the report
key_terms.لَمْ يَرْجِعْ فِيهِ: he did not return by that same route
key_terms.مِنًى: Minā, the well-known location of the hajj rites

ai.seo_question: What route did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله take from Minā, and did he return by the same path?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the route of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله during his movement from Minā and his return by a different way. It reflects a prophetic practice in the rites and movements connected to hajj, preserving a detail of his sunnah (prophetic tradition).
